newsitem.title: USA: Mississippi Chemical sees Q3 EPS $0.35-$0.40.
newsitem.headline: Mississippi Chemical sees Q3 EPS $0.35-$0.40.

text.p: Mississippi Chemical Corp, a major fertilizer manufacturer, said Wednesday it expects earnings of $0.35 to $0.40 a share for the fiscal third quarter ended March 31 -- below analysts' consensus estimate.

The projection, which is based on preliminary sales and cost figures, primarily reflects a delay in seasonal fertilizer applications due to wet weather throughout the company's primary trade area, it said.

Charles Dunn, president and chief executive officer, said the company was confronted with an unusual number of adverse events during the quarter, particularly the persistent rains during March. By the end of the month, however, the weather outlook had improved and the fertilizer season is now in full swing, he said.

"While we remain cautious about the near-term pricing outlook, we expect to recover in the fourth quarter much of the weather-related lost volume," he said. The company has also overcome start-up difficulties at its Ampro ammonia facility, he added.
The company said weak demand for nitrogen products during the quarter caused prices for most of its products to decline.
Phosphate prices were also well below year-ago levels due to soft international demand, while production at its Ampro facility was lower than expected due to a major modification at the site.

It said it experienced significantly higher production costs at its Carlsbad, N.M., potash facilities due to operating difficulties at two newly acquired potash mines, as well as higher energy costs and the mining of a low-grade ore zone.
